summary: Google DeepMind's CEO announced Gemini 3.7 Flash, a new Flash-tier model version with upgrades for software engineering, web development and knowledge work, launched at half the introductory price of the prior 3.6 Flash.

practices.reason: The post states capability gains in coding and knowledge-work tasks plus a concrete price halving, but gives no benchmark evidence for the capability claims.
practices.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash brings major upgrades for software engineering, web dev & knowledge work. And introductory price is half the original 3.6 Flash cost.

practices.reason: A stated price change for the model tier means teams should update cost planning and API usage budgets for the new Flash version.
practices.quote: introductory price is half the original 3.6 Flash cost
